title: core.fulfillment.dispatched v1
description: Published by CORE when MOVE accepts a fulfillment request and binds it to an operational job. Marks the transition coordinating -> dispatched. MARKET consumes it to show the commercial order as assigned; the job reference stays opaque to MARKET.

organization_id.description: The CORE organization (tenant) this fulfillment belongs to. CORE owns tenancy and is the only system that can state it, so it is stated here rather than left for a consumer to ask back for. Added in the 2026-09-12 tenant-scope cycle to resolve blocker B-23: without it a consumer could not route a closure by tenant, and a tenant-scoped notification recipient for this event type matched nothing, for ever, with no error anywhere. Every event CORE publishes from that cycle onward carries it; events stored before it do not, so a consumer replaying history must treat an absent value as unknown rather than as a tenant.

job_reference.description: Opaque MOVE operational job reference. CORE never interprets it.
